name: Grasp

boost.name: Respect
effect: At the start of your next turn, draw 2 and discard this.
NOW: Advance up to 3.
HIT: Push or Pull 1 or 2.

name: Cross

boost.name: Superior
effect: Your attack is considered to be an EX Attack (+1 Power, +1 Speed, +1 Armor and +1 Guard).
AFTER: Retreat 3.

name: Assault

boost.name: Air Dash
effect: Close or Retreat 3.
BEFORE: Close 2.
HIT: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the strike).

name: Dive

boost.name: Reading
effect: Name a Normal Attack, then Strike. The opponent must Strike with that card or reveal a hand without any.
BEFORE: Advance 3. If you Advanced past the opponent, their attacks do not hit you.

name: Spike

boost.name: Mixup
effect: Close or Retreat 1, then Strike. Draw 1 after setting your attack.
Ignore Armor. Ignore Guard.

name: Sweep

boost.name: Just Defense
effect: +3 Armor.
NOW: Strike.
AFTER: Lose all Armor.
HIT: The opponent must discard a card at random.

name: Focus

boost.name: Veil Off
effect: Exceed and add this to your Gauge (you do not have to pay any costs to Exceed).
You cannot be Pushed or Pulled.
AFTER: Draw 1.

name: Block

boost.name: Tech Hit
effect: Discard a boost in play, then Strike.
When you are hit (after Hit effects), spend any amount of Force for +2 Armor per Force spent.
AFTER: Add this to your Gauge at the end of the Strike.
